```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidypopgen)
library(tidyr)
library(Matrix)
library(ggalign)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- "../results/s12_FST/"
```

# Load and group gt

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_clean_ld.gt")
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% group_by(population)
```

# Loci and sample count

```{r}
nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
```

# Impute

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- gt_impute_simple(mad_bor_g1000_sum, method = "random")
gt_set_imputed(mad_bor_g1000_sum, TRUE)
```

# LD clumping

```{r}
to_keep_LD <- loci_ld_clump(mad_bor_g1000_sum, thr_r2 = 0.2, size = 100, return_id = TRUE, use_positions = TRUE)

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% select_loci(all_of(to_keep_LD))
```

# Loci and sample count

```{r}
nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
```

# Pairwise Fst

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% 
  pairwise_pop_fst(by_locus = FALSE, method = "Hudson")
```

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst
```


```{r}

 mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_1 <- factor(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_1, levels = unique(mad_bor_g1000_sum$population))
 mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_2 <- factor(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_2, levels = unique(mad_bor_g1000_sum$population))


# transform mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_1 to numeric and add as $pop_1
mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$pop_1 <- as.numeric(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_1)
mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$pop_2 <- as.numeric(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_2)


fst_matrix <- matrix(nrow = 20, ncol = 20)

# Fill matrix
for (i in seq_len(nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst))) {

  x <- as.numeric(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst[i, 4])
  y <- as.numeric(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst[i, 5])

  fst_matrix[x, y] <- mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$value[i]
  fst_matrix[y, x] <- mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$value[i]
}

diag(fst_matrix) <- 0

rownames(fst_matrix) <- levels(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_1)
colnames(fst_matrix) <- levels(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_2)

```


https://stackoverflow.com/questions/38727324/adding-a-dendrogram-to-a-ggplot2-heatmap 
https://yunuuuu.github.io/ggalign-book/complexheatmap-single-heatmap.html


```{r}
ggheatmap(fst_matrix) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -60, hjust = 0))
```


```{r}
# subset fst matrix to rows in c("Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego", "Sakalava Tsimihety", "Betsileo", "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro", "ESN", "Borneo")

sub <- c("Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego", "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Betsileo", "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro", "ESN", "Borneo")

fst_matrix_sub <- as.data.frame(fst_matrix)
rm <- names(fst_matrix_sub)[(names(fst_matrix_sub) %in% sub)]
fst_matrix_sub <- fst_matrix_sub[,rm]

fst_matrix_sub <- subset(fst_matrix_sub, rownames(fst_matrix_sub) %in% c("Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego", "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Betsileo", "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro", "ESN", "Borneo"))

```

```{r}
ggheatmap(fst_matrix_sub) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(expression("F"[st])) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -60, hjust = 0))
```


# Population level FIS for Merina subsets

```{r}
# Load fastmixture Q matrix
qmats <- readRDS("../data/intermediate/fastmixture/fastmixture_m.RData")
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_clean.gt")
```

```{r}
# tidy with the gt
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- augment(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 3, run = 1), data = mad_bor_g1000_sum)
# filter to merina
merina <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% filter(population == "Merina")
# split groups
merina$population <- ifelse(merina$.Q3 > 0.5, "MerinaA", "MerinaB")
merina <- merina[, c("id", "population")]
#merina$id <- sub("RR.*", "", merina$id)

# match V2 and merina$id and replace the population column in merina_fam with the population column in merina
matching_m <- match(mad_bor_g1000_sum$id, merina$id)
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_m), merina$population[matching_m], mad_bor_g1000_sum$population)

```

# Pairwise Fst

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% filter(population %in% c("Betsimisaraka", "MerinaA","MerinaB", "Diego", "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Betsileo", "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro"))

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% group_by(population)
mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% 
  pairwise_pop_fst(by_locus = FALSE, method = "Hudson")
```

```{r}
 mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_1 <- factor(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_1, levels = unique(mad_bor_g1000_sum$population))
 mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_2 <- factor(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_2, levels = unique(mad_bor_g1000_sum$population))


# transform mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_1 to numeric and add as $pop_1
mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$pop_1 <- as.numeric(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_1)
mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$pop_2 <- as.numeric(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_2)


fst_matrix <- matrix(nrow = 9, ncol = 9)

# Fill matrix
for (i in seq_len(nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst))) {
  
  x <- as.numeric(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst[i, 4])
  y <- as.numeric(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst[i, 5])
  
  # x <- as.numeric(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_1[i])
  # y <- as.numeric(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_2[i])

  fst_matrix[x, y] <- mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$value[i]
  fst_matrix[y, x] <- mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$value[i]
}

diag(fst_matrix) <- 0

rownames(fst_matrix) <- levels(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_1)
colnames(fst_matrix) <- levels(mad_bor_g1000_sum_fst$population_2)

```


```{r}
ggheatmap(fst_matrix) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = expression("F"[st])) +
  anno_right(size = unit(15, "mm")) +
    align_dendro(reorder_dendrogram = TRUE) +
    anno_top(size = unit(15, "mm")) +
    align_dendro(reorder_dendrogram = TRUE) +
    quad_active() &
    theme(plot.margin = margin()) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -60, hjust = 0))#theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -60, hjust = 0))

#ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "fst_merina_split.jpg"), width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

ggheatmap(fst_matrix) +
